item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00145","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C21","C05","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C21","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C21 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both proclamations concern a Pacific-oriented exposition or festival, recite congressional authorization for presidential invitations and the benefits of international participation, and culminate in the distinctive machinery of authorizing and directing the Secretary of State to invite, on the President's behalf, such foreign countries or nations as the Secretary considers appropriate. C05 and C18 share the event/invitation structure, but their operative clauses have the President directly invite states and foreign countries and therefore are less exact templates.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Congress, by a joint resolution approved September 14, 1959, has authorized and requested the President to issue a proclamation inviting foreign nations to participate in the 1959 Pacific Festival","parent_excerpt":"the Congress, by an act approved September 2, 1958 ... has authorized the President, by proclamation or in such manner as he may deem proper, to invite the several States of the Union and foreign countries to take part in the Exposition","explanation":"Both use congressional authorization to frame an invitation to foreign participation in a Pacific-focused event."},{"child_excerpt":"participation by both American citizens and foreign nationals in this event is in keeping with our objective of cultivating better relationships among the nations and the peoples of the world; and it may be expected to contribute to the welfare and benefit of all concerned","parent_excerpt":"such participation by the several States and foreign countries will contribute to the welfare of all participants by promoting domestic and inter-national commerce and furthering understanding among peoples through the interchange of scientific and cultural knowledge","explanation":"The child adapts C21's welfare-and-international-understanding justification to the festival's stated purpose."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby authorize and direct the Secretary of State to invite, on my behalf, such foreign nations as he may consider appropriate to participate in the 1959 Pacific Festival","parent_excerpt":"do hereby authorize and direct the Secretary of State to invite, on my behalf, such foreign countries as he may consider appropriate to take part in the World Science-Pan Pacific Exposition","explanation":"This is highly distinctive, nearly verbatim operative language using the same delegated invitation mechanism, with only the event and minor wording changed."}]}
